meta.sourceNote: Hand-authored approximation of Georgetown, Washington DC, reconstructed from general geographic knowledge. Not OpenStreetMap data; not survey-accurate.
meta.frame: equirectangular around origin; x east, z south, y up; metres rounded to 0.1
meta.winding: outer rings counter-clockwise on a north-up map (negative shoelace area in raw x,z), holes the other way; rings do not repeat the first point
meta.notes: Synthetic: generated by scripts/georgetownFromSpec.mjs from a hand-authored spec (general knowledge, not OpenStreetMap, 20-80 m error). ids are s<n>, unique across all lists. Streets, water, parks and landmark positions come from the spec; every building is synthesized (synth: true); POIs carry categories only (name them from src/data/poiNames.ts). Road and footway vertices shared by several ways are identical, so graphs can be built by matching coordinates. Streets that cross the canal are split into a short bridge piece. heights: grid of terrain heights, data[iz * nx + ix] at (x0 + ix * spacing, z0 + iz * spacing).
meta.attribution: Hand-authored approximation of Georgetown, Washington DC (not OpenStreetMap data); buildings, POIs, sidewalks, props and heights are synthesized.
